# Daily Dive Core Engine

[![Build Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-brightgreen.svg)](https://example.com)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

Daily Dive delivers curated daily micro-learning concepts across computing, architecture, mental models, and career strategies.

## Architectural Principles
- Local-first client execution: All user telemetry, streaks, and progress records remain encrypted in local browser storage.
- Deterministic spaced repetition: Concepts resurface on spaced intervals calibrated to retention curves.
- Zero tracking: Source notes and uploaded documents never transmit over external networks.

## Getting Started
Run `npm run dev` to launch the local Vite development server on port 5173.
